question: How many employees did DOOR, formerly Latch, announce it was laying off in August 2026?

hits.title: Dealroom.co | DOOR cuts 32% of workforce, exits property management to save $10-12M annually
hits.snippet: The company expects these actions, along with earlier 2026 cost-saving measures, to reduce annualised costs by approximately $10 to $12 million. The restructuring will eliminate roughly 65 roles globally, including contract labour in Europe ...

hits.title: Opendoor Layoffs 2026 - 250 Jobs Cut | layoffhedge
hits.snippet: Opendoor laid off 250 employees in 2026. 18% of workforce. Source: Opendoor CEO memo / X.

hits.title: STL-based Latch cuts workforce | Springfield Business Journal
hits.snippet: Louis-based Latch Inc., which is now doing business as Door, announcing a restructuring plan. The company plans to cut its workforce to the tune of 32%. Additionally, the company will exit its property management operations. Read more from Investing.com. ... Springfield-based financial advisory ...

hits.title: DOOR Announces Strategic Actions to Accelerate Path to Profitability and Advance Its Building Intelligence Strategy
hits.snippet: Workforce Reduction The restructuring plan eliminates approximately 65 roles globally. The reduction is concentrated in contract labor support in Europe and includes approximately 10 percent of the Company's active U.S. employee base.

hits.title: Layoffs Tracker - All Tech and Startup Layoffs
hits.snippet: The latest layoffs across all tech companies. So far in 2026, there have been 535 layoffs at tech companies with 175,479 people impacted (766 people per day).

hits.title: SF tech company once worth $18B lays off 300 workers as losses mount
hits.snippet: Opendoor, a San Francisco tech company that buys and sells homes, is laying off 300 workers as losses rack up. It’s the third large layoff in about two years.

hits.title: Opendoor Lays Off 18% Of Staff – NMP
hits.snippet: Opendoor’s CEO Eric Wu announced in a blog post Wednesday that the company is laying off around 550 people. That's about 18% of the staff, according to Wu.

hits.title: List of Companies Laying off Employees in August - Newsweek
hits.snippet: WARN notices are typically required when companies with 100 or more employees plan a mass layoff or plant closing affecting at least 50 workers. These are some of the companies planning layoffs in August.

hits.title: Opendoor lays off about 550 employees, or 18% of its workforce | TechCrunch
hits.snippet: Opendoor is letting go of about 550 people, or 18% of the company, across all functions, its co-founder and CEO Eric Wu announced in a blog post today.

hits.title: Opendoor lays off 40 more workers amid ongoing struggles
hits.snippet: Faced with ongoing volatility, both Opendoor and Offerpad have dramatically scaled back their homebuying operations, shrinking inventory pipelines and tightening margins. Last week, the company announced plans for a reverse stock split in an attempt to avoid Nasdaq delisting — after shares dipped below $1 and remained there.

accuracy.note: Answer states approximately 65, matching gold headcount

ar.note: Ranks 1 and 4 state DOOR eliminating ~65 roles globally; others reference Opendoor or lack the 65 figure.
